description: Synthetic population, census and cadastral data - La Unión (Spain) [Dataset] Población sintética generada, datos censales y catastrales de la La Unión (zona de estudio) [Dataset] is a data set deposited in lcch.sgbnja by its authors Salvador Martínez-Artero Martínez, Lorenzo Brian Ros McDonnell (Universidad Politécnica de Cartagena). [ENG] File 1 -Census dataset identifying each household and its resident population in the city of La Unión located within the study area, as of 12/10/2025. Data extracted from the database of the Spanish National Statistics Institute (INE). (https://www.ine.es/). File 2-Classification of household types. Coverage: national (ES); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
